effective_protocol.purpose: Probe open-loop geometric reconstruction and the effect of an explicit attachment constraint, after the image-ingestion pilot but before collecting reconstruction answers.
effective_protocol.system_prompt: You are creating a Blender Python script from a reference image. Use only the image and instructions in this conversation. Return exactly one JSON object without Markdown fences, with keys script (the complete Python source as a string), description (a short string), and uncertainty (an array of strings).

conditions.prompt: Write a self-contained Blender 5.2 Python script that builds a 3D sculpture corresponding to the drawing. Match the visible parts, their arrangement and overall form. The geometry may be stylised. Use an overall height of approximately 100 Blender units. Z is up; the front of the sculpture faces negative Y. Create geometry only: no cameras, lights, rendering, file reads or writes, external assets, add-ons, shell commands or network access. You may import only bpy, math and mathutils. Clear the starting scene and build the sculpture. Overlapping solid meshes are acceptable for this visual study; watertightness will not be scored. Return the script, a short description, and uncertainties as the requested JSON object.

Write a self-contained Blender 5.2 Python script that builds a 3D sculpture corresponding to the drawing. Match the visible parts, their arrangement and overall form. The geometry may be stylised. Use an overall height of approximately 100 Blender units. Z is up; the front of the sculpture faces negative Y. Create geometry only: no cameras, lights, rendering, file reads or writes, external assets, add-ons, shell commands or network access. You may import only bpy, math and mathutils. Clear the starting scene and build the sculpture. Overlapping solid meshes are acceptable for this visual study; watertightness will not be scored. Additional constraint: the cable's free end must end in a distinct plug seated in a socket on the front face of that same power strip, perpendicular to the socket face. The occupied socket can be hidden by the plug; retain two other visible empty sockets above it. The plug must mate with the strip, rather than enter the head beside it. Return the script, a short description, and uncertainties as the requested JSON object.

scoring_plan.method: Inspect generated source and front/oblique renders. Score whether the plug mates visibly with the strip's socket-bearing face, whether the cable meets the plug, whether a plug-shaped end is present, and whether geometry executes. Retain ambiguous cases. Do not infer success from object names or the model's description alone.
scoring_plan.execution: Review the generated script before executing it. Rendering and saving are performed by the experimenter's wrapper, not by the model. Retain errors and any compatibility corrections; never silently repair the scene.

limitations: Two fresh sessions per condition are illustrative and cannot establish a reliable treatment effect.

The explicit condition supplies an intended interpretation of an ambiguous drawing as well as a geometric constraint, so any improvement cannot be attributed uniquely to attention or geometry planning.
This is open-loop code generation with no tool access or rendered feedback to the generating session. It does not reproduce the original benchmark's unknown agent workflow.
The fixed scale, orientation, Blender API and allowance for overlapping meshes differ from an unrestricted modelling or printing task.
The control and explicit prompts differ only by the additional constraint sentence group. Calls are fresh, not paired by a random seed.
The image pilot was read before this follow-up protocol was committed. Its response expressed uncertainty about the plug's depicted attachment.
